Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow Home Living** (formerly Covey & Lark Retail), not Pellucid Harbor Logistics. That's the account you run, and the February thread in #coastal-team says so: "Sofia's retail account is the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6... Not the container pickup."

The "PHL" code is shared by both accounts, which is why you and Kwame got tangled. The February 16 rebrand notice also says the door 6 desk was confused by the old Covey & Lark heading on the export, so this is the same delivery under the new name.
